name: Rizuhble's Heaven Sent Headshots
rows: Getting poked out in lane. Back off before you use it. Sell it once you're out of slots.
Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.
Get after Counterspell if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Enduring Speed for it.
Their gun heroes shoot you out of the sky.
Most of their damage is gun.
Most of their damage is spirit.
Stuns and Knockdown keep dropping you out of Flight.
Slows and hexes keep landing on you.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Round 13: new pure sniper build (the existing one is the gun/spirit hybrid with Assassinate charges). No current public build is pure gun: the top gun-labelled ones (lockbuilds 'turbo absolute gun vindicta', Oct 11; deadlocklabs 'One Shot Assassinate') still open with spirit. So the gun items come from the gun half of those builds (turbo: Long Range, HV, Rapid Rounds, Counterspell, Sharpshooter, Burst Fire, Bullet Lifesteal → Vampiric Burst, Lucky Shot; deadlocklabs: HV, Long Range, Burst Fire, Crippling Headshot), and the rest is picked by kit for a style with no spirit: Headhunter (sustain off headshots from range), Hollow Point and Battle Vest (she fights from the air above 65% health), Extended → Titanic Magazine (Flight T1 +50% ammo while flying), Glass Cannon (snowball off picks once health is in). No hero-wide pick rates used. Order: seemeta most popular (61.0%, 2,910 matches) 3221144411332243; nothing in it depends on spirit items, Flight T1 at point 3 and ult early.

Round 14: rebuilt as the snipe (Assassinate) build. 'Sniper' Vindicta builds post-patch are Assassinate spirit builds (lockbuilds MAX SNIPE DMG Sep 17, pentagram 'snipe' Oct 18, turbo absolute Oct 1 spirit/util way), while the round-13 version was a second gun build with Headhunter (metabot 6795: 1.2% pick, 47.3% WR), Battle Vest (41.4% WR), Hollow Point and Glass Cannon, which no post-patch Vindicta build uses together. Items now: Extra Spirit → Improved Spirit → Boundless, Mystic Burst → Tankbuster, Extra Charge → Rapid Recharge, Sprint Boots → Enduring Speed, Counterspell, Mystic Vulnerability → Escalating Exposure, Compress → Superior Cooldown, Surge of Power, Diviner's Kevlar, Mystic Reverb and Lightning Scroll (both work off Assassinate), Spirit Lifesteal → Spiritual Overflow. Ability order maxes Assassinate first. Renamed Pure Sniper.
Round 17: Divine Barrier rich note 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (Dispel Magic is in Counters). Name 'Pure Sniper Vindicta' kept (Kieran's words).
Round 20: late list Spirit Burn, Refresher; Juggernaut added to Slot locked so Enduring Speed upgrades. Core+late 76.8k.
Round 23: kit re-read, no item change (see log).
